studies.title: Writer, memory and later probe
studies.description: An earlier prepared carrier writes a retained clock phase. The same later probe is suppressed or transmitted in four accepted groups across two board sizes.
studies.scope: History-dependent output; no unique preferred route or internally generated approval has been established.

studies.title: Where the retained influence resides
studies.description: Separately prepared region/exterior crosses isolate the seven-node clock region that predicts the later carrier response.
studies.scope: Each cross is a new initial preparation. No running board is edited.

studies.title: A carrier returns to its clock
studies.description: One initially prepared carrier revisits the clock through the periodic guide. Complete continuing examples close their entire board orbit after 50 or 54 updates.
studies.scope: Finite returned carriers and exact recurrence; periodic wrapping is intentional.

studies.title: Thirty-two return opportunities
studies.description: The unresolved L48/L52 preparations are followed through 1,576 or 1,704 updates. The registered joint carrier does not reappear after loss.
studies.scope: All complete controls are retained across four pages. Missing the declared template does not mean all microscopic activity vanished.

studies.title: Signal-driven paired clocks
studies.description: An incoming carrier can change the phase of a prepared stationary period-five clock pair. Core and outer-halo events are recorded separately.
studies.scope: Zero registered separated-product pairs. The corrected analysis withdraws the earlier observer positives. Four delay-seven display examples were added after analysis.

studies.title: Six inputs and division with remainder
studies.description: Compare prepared donor amplitudes and simultaneous unit inputs. The unchanged arithmetic produces different quotients, retained remainders and all three guarded C classes.
studies.scope: Arithmetic fanout and local thresholds, not a conserved division of light or a route-selection rule.

studies.title: A control that failed
studies.description: The original writer-removal preparation retained a remainder defect. The probe-only input failed, so no conditional gate was accepted in that study.
studies.scope: Eight prospectively selected failed-target controls remain visible; later studies do not rewrite this result.
